tokens.name: bg-viewport
tokens.usage: 3D viewport background; everything else floats above it.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Fill of floating panels, top bar, tool dock, context menu.

tokens.name: bg-section
tokens.usage: Collapsible section header boxes inside a panel (Solids, Curve).

tokens.name: bg-field
tokens.usage: Search field, header chevron button, coordinate value chips, toggle track.

tokens.name: bg-inset
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: numeric inputs, command bar, file-name pill. Darker than the panel on purpose.

tokens.name: bg-active
tokens.usage: Selected icon button, active segment, keyboard badge, secondary button, plan buttons.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: 1px outline of every panel, box, toolbar and field group.

tokens.name: viewport-grid
tokens.usage: 1px grid lines on the viewport floor.

tokens.name: viewport-ground-axis
tokens.usage: The green ground axis line through the grid origin.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Values, titles, menu items, active icons. On every surface above (15:1+ on bg-panel).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Outliner rows, icon strokes at rest. 5.7:1 on bg-panel.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Section header labels, inactive tab text. Source value: 4.3:1 on bg-section, just under 4.5 — keep it at 13px+ medium.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Placeholder text only (find a layer…, Command). Source value: 3.2:1 on bg-field — never use for real content.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Labels on disabled-looking buttons (Plan from selection). 3.9:1 on bg-active.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: The only saturated UI fill: active snap toggle, focus ring, selection in lists. Use sparingly.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent-primary (4.6:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline on any control; 3.9:1 on bg-panel.

tokens.name: chip-bridge-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the amber operation chip (Bridge).

tokens.name: chip-bridge-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the amber chip; 8:1 on chip-bridge-bg.

tokens.name: chip-split-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the blue operation chip (Split).

tokens.name: chip-split-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the blue chip. Source value: 3.4:1 on chip-split-bg — below 4.5, kept exact; lighten to #4a8fe6 if legibility matters more than fidelity.

tokens.name: chip-boolean-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the green operation chip (Boolean).

tokens.name: chip-boolean-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the green chip; 8.5:1 on chip-boolean-bg.

tokens.name: badge-pro-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the account badge (Pro User).

tokens.name: badge-pro-fg
tokens.usage: Text of the account badge.

tokens.name: badge-pro-border
tokens.usage: 1px outline of the account badge.

tokens.name: selection-highlight
tokens.usage: Viewport highlight of selected edges/faces and the transform gizmo pivot.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X axis: unit text in the coordinate readout, X gizmo handle. Brightened from the antialiased mockup sample (#9f1828).

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y axis: unit text, Y gizmo handle.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Z axis: unit text, Z gizmo handle. Brightened from the mockup sample (#316595).

tokens.name: gizmo-x
tokens.usage: Red face of the view cube orb (top right of the viewport).

tokens.name: gizmo-y
tokens.usage: Green face of the view cube orb.

tokens.name: gizmo-z
tokens.usage: Blue face of the view cube orb.

styles.name: axis
